basis: Obligations are enumerated from the repository declarations alone: the C# route requirements and cases of the qualification inventory, the production/fact alternatives of feature-alternatives.json, the declaration mapping of fact-mapping.json and the registered case sources of the native fixtures. No native or reference output is read and no expected value is derived here: every state is NO_EXPECTED unless the sealed expected asset (SEALED, or BLOCKED with its reason code) or the executed asset (EXECUTED) says otherwise, and the ledger takes only alternative IDs, rows, statuses and reason codes from them. An alternative's presence is a static check of the literals its production requires (top-level quoted terminals that are not optional) against the source versions of its linked P steps; it is textual (comments and strings are not excluded), so LITERAL_MATCH with PUNCTUATION strength proves little, and an alternative with no such literal is UNVERIFIED_PRESENCE. Out-of-mapping declaration constructs come from a hand-declared construct table matched against the alternatives' production heads. Revision r2 (G1-3b) reads, for the rows csharp-B03 and csharp-B04, the post-seal corrected expected asset (csharp-g1-expected-b03b04-r2.json) and its executed asset (csharp-g1-executed-b03b04-r2.json), re-derived from the same stored native observation, in addition to the r2 pair of csharp-B01 and csharp-B02: only IDs, rows, statuses, reason codes and results are taken from them. The sealed r1 assets remain unchanged; the r2 pair records four corrected matches and one new BLOCKED disposition after the native comparison, not independent agreement. Both pairs are checked per row: no expected asset names an alternative twice or outside the ledger or its rows, and the one of csharp-B03 and csharp-B04 names every alternative of its rows, and an executed asset names a SEALED alternative of its own rows once. An alternative is EXECUTED only when the executed asset says MATCH; MISMATCH stays SEALED. The P obligation of a row is SEALED or EXECUTED only when every alternative of the row is, so it stays NO_EXPECTED while an alternative of the row is BLOCKED or NO_EXPECTED.
